data.title: 白井黑子 · 训练道场的微汗小憩
data.description: 宽敞整洁的体能训练道场内，夕阳从高窗斜射入光柱。刚结束高强度体术训练的黑子坐在木地板上，脖颈上搭着白毛巾，运动背心贴身勾勒出紧致挺拔的优美线条。她微微仰头擦拭锁骨处的细汗，清秀的脸庞泛着动人的红晕，目光灼灼地注视着来人。
data.location: traditional martial arts dojo with polished wooden floorboards and high windows
data.action: sitting on wooden dojo floor after workout, towel around neck, athletic tank top, perspiration on collarbone, flushed cheeks, intense earnest gaze
data.lighting: striking golden dust-mote beams streaming from high gym windows
data.mood: disciplined athletic beauty, magnetizing focused vulnerability
data.promptProse: Resting on polished wooden dojo floors after a rigorous workout, Kuroko drapes a white towel over her neck. Sweat glistens on her collarbones in the sunset light as her brown eyes gaze forward with earnest dedication.
data.animaCaption: Kuroko resting in a sunlit dojo in a tank top, wiping sweat from her neck with a towel.
